note: One system, one baseline and three hardening guides, modelled with each approach. The scenario compares document counts and system security plan content, not overall capability. Counts derive from the corpus, the NIST profile in data/scenario-evidence/, or OSCAL schema constraints. Each file row records the applicable constraint.
title: One system, three hardening guides
summary: A system follows the NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 High baseline and hardening guides for Ubuntu, PostgreSQL and Microsoft 365. The three approaches model the same requirements, using every OSCAL model except the plan of action and milestones.

excluded_model.reason: The plan of action and milestones records unmet requirements and remediation. The document serves the same purpose in all three approaches and is excluded from the comparison.

framework.label: NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5, High baseline
framework.derivation: count of /profile/imports/0/include-controls/0/with-ids in the published HIGH baseline profile, version 5.2.0

hardening.label: CIS Ubuntu 24.04 LTS Benchmark
hardening.derivation: count of steps titled 'Audit for ...' in Easy Dynamics/Center for Internet Security/CIS_Ubuntu_Linux_24_04_LTS_Benchmark_v2_OSCAL_AP.json. The file carries 616 steps, one audit and one remediation for each recommendation, in 53 activities.

hardening.label: DISA STIG PostgreSQL 16
hardening.derivation: count of props step-type=check in Easy Dynamics/DISA/STIG_XCCDF to OSCAL Assessment Plans/postgres16.json. The file carries 111 activities and 222 steps, one check and one remediate for each.
hardening.source: Easy Dynamics/DISA/STIG_XCCDF to OSCAL Assessment Plans/postgres16.json

hardening.label: CISA BOD 25-01 SCuBA
hardening.derivation: count of steps in Easy Dynamics/CISA BOD 25-01/ap-cisa-scuba-agnostic.json, which carries 128 steps across 7 activities, one activity per Microsoft 365 service.
